summary: Tested iter71 features: AI post-mortem of closed trades (analyze/cached/detail/404/fresh real AI call), price_action.facts unit cases + prompt injection (crypto & FX _build_prompt), position_review.due unit, ai_position_review_* settings persistence/validation on /api and /api/fx, POST /api/fx|pepper/positions/ai-review (real AI), and UI on /hotforex (positions badge + Revisar con IA toast, Historial analyze buttons, trade detail AI review block, Ajustes block toggle/mode/save), /bybit and /pepperstone regression. 15/15 pytest passed; all UI checks passed; no console errors on the 3 dashboards.
critical_code_review_comments: position_review.review_open_positions always uses crypto `models.Position` to parse docs, including FX/Pepper positions. It worked for the seeded XAUUSD position, but any field that only exists on the FX Position model is dropped from p.model_dump() before it goes to the AI. Use the engine's own Position class.

No concurrency guard on POST /trades/{id}/analyze or /positions/ai-review. A double click or two tabs can fire two paid AI calls, and in auto mode two review cycles could both try to close the same position. Add a per-engine lock or busy flag.

engine._ai_review_last is set before the loop, so if every position fails (candles/AI error), the next attempt still waits the full interval. This is acceptable, but log one summary line when that happens.
Seeded GBPUSD trades have entry 1.3155 while Yahoo candles for that window are about 1.334-1.340. The AI itself flagged the mismatch in chart_context. This is a seed-data artefact, not a code bug.
seed_data_creation: None created. Running the fresh analysis stored ai_review on the previously unanalyzed GBPUSD trade 6aee7451d30c090fe3627972 (expected by the request). The positions AI review overwrote position.ai_review on XAUUSD 6aee74a630b35597d99f7bf1 (still MANTENER 68%). The position is still open.
